finding_dispositions.regression_analysis: The real AF_UNIX helper reduces SO_SNDBUF and asyncio write-buffer watermarks without enlarging product limits. A non-reading peer forces a nonzero buffer. Timeout and cancellation are exercised through exchange_frozen and through the actual owner. The owner regression records buffer_at_a_exit at the second native_preparation_commit context used by _model_protocol, requires zero at that boundary, then requires zero at return and no newline-terminated complete frame when the peer is finally released. The timeout path uses LocalControl; cancellation calls the actual owner directly. Replay checks retain SENT/UNKNOWN and require no new authority call. Transaction ownership/locks remain SOURCE doubles, not PostgreSQL overlap.
